plugins.name: ant-farm
plugins.description: Mission control for your subagents: what each one is doing, its activity and its cost, live.

plugins.name: bouncer
plugins.description: Checks each mod at the door and lists what it can reach, from Claude Code's own validator.

plugins.name: chapters
plugins.description: A diff, told in ordered chapters with risk marks, and a pane that walks you through them.

plugins.name: cloakroom
plugins.description: Check your secrets at the door. Claude gets a ticket; the real value only comes back where you allow it.

plugins.name: crossroads
plugins.description: Three ways forward after every turn, risky ones marked. About $0.0002 a turn.

plugins.name: fine-print
plugins.description: A second reader that flags what you would miss in a wall of text.

plugins.name: footprints
plugins.description: A live file tree beside the chat that shows where Claude has been.

plugins.name: halftime
plugins.description: Claude works, you play. The whistle blows the moment it needs you.

plugins.name: hatchling
plugins.description: A collectible pixel pet that hatches, reacts and evolves while you code.

plugins.name: headway
plugins.description: See how far along Claude is, and when it will land.

plugins.name: last-look
plugins.description: Holds destructive commands until you approve, and shows what they would destroy.

plugins.name: mulligan
plugins.description: A do-over for risky shell commands: it saves your files first, and /mulligan puts them back.

plugins.name: noted
plugins.description: Turns your corrections into permanent rules, without duplicates.

plugins.name: pager
plugins.description: Plays a sound when Claude finishes, needs you or hits an error.

plugins.name: play-by-play
plugins.description: Replays every change Claude made in a turn, shell edits included.

plugins.name: pop-quiz
plugins.description: Two short questions about Claude's latest code change, answers one press away. Off by default.

plugins.name: porthole
plugins.description: A live preview of the app you are building, right beside the chat.

plugins.name: rain-check
plugins.description: Hit your usage limit? Your prompt waits and goes out when the limit resets.

plugins.name: redline
plugins.description: Context fill, session cost and pace on one line, with a warning before the red line.

plugins.name: second-wind
plugins.description: A breath, an eye rest or a stretch while Claude works, sized to the wait.

plugins.name: swear-jar
plugins.description: Counts the model's verbal tics, from "You're absolutely right" to the em dash.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Every Claude Code session on your machine in one pane, and which one needs you.

plugins.name: thermostat
plugins.description: Shows when your prompt cache goes cold, and stops the expensive send.

plugins.name: umpire
plugins.description: Runs your tests after Claude edits code and makes the call. Off by default.

plugins.name: wardrobe
plugins.description: Restyle Claude Code live, including colourblind-safe and high-contrast themes.
